description: Source code for a client library interfacing with a server API for a project management or collaboration tool, providing methods for managing boards, cards, blocks, users, and related entities.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: A client for interacting with the server API, managing authentication, and performing CRUD operations on boards, cards, blocks, users, and other entities.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response with status code, error, and headers.

classes.name: RequestReaderError
classes.description: Custom error type for payload reading errors.

methods.name: NewClient
methods.description: Creates a new API client instance with the specified URL and session token.

methods.name: DoAPIGet
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the API.

methods.name: DoAPIPost
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to the API.

methods.name: DoAPIPatch
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PATCH request to the API.

methods.name: DoAPIPut
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT request to the API.

methods.name: DoAPIDelete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request to the API.

methods.name: GetBoard
methods.description: Retrieves a board by ID, with optional read token.

methods.name: GetBoardsForTeam
methods.description: Retrieves all boards for a specific team.

methods.name: AddMemberToBoard
methods.description: Adds a member to a board.

methods.name: DeleteBoardMember
methods.description: Removes a member from a board.

methods.name: CreateCard
methods.description: Creates a new card on a board.

methods.name: GetCards
methods.description: Retrieves cards from a board with pagination.

methods.name: UpdateCategoryBoard
methods.description: Associates a board with a category.

methods.name: GetUserCategoryBoards
methods.description: Retrieves category boards for a team.

methods.name: GetSharing
methods.description: Retrieves sharing info for a board.

methods.name: PostSharing
methods.description: Updates sharing info for a board.

methods.name: GetUserList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of users by IDs.

methods.name: HideBoard
methods.description: Hides a board within a category.

methods.name: UnhideBoard
methods.description: Unhides a board within a category.
